phase: P1 eighth increment: bounded process primitive, financial settlement fairness and real spawn/PG recovery acceptance
implemented: DirectionalSettlementStage retains an independent non-authoritative in-memory financial cursor. BLOCKED, BUSY and exceptions advance attempted work; closed-fill, lifecycle and account filters, account locks, financial checks and risk release rules are unchanged.

A successful page is not global clearance: requery current scoped pending obligations before CLEAR. Already unresolved pages remain BLOCKED without an extra scan. Query failure cannot manufacture CLEAR.

New unwired BoundedProcessJob owns one direct spawn child. Fixed IPC statuses only; absolute work/cooperative/terminate/kill deadlines; nonblocking poll/stop; late polling does not extend grace. Unconfirmed stop retains the handle and prevents replacement.

Cooperative stop uses a lock-free shared byte instead of multiprocessing.Event.set and its cross-process Condition. It is a hint, never an execution fence or stop proof. Child wait polls; owner must regularly poll the job.

Real spawn/isolated-PG tests exercise actual settlement cash/ledger commits, hung GET while holding the protocol account lock, ignored SIGTERM followed by kill, actual lock reacquisition, committed-success-with-missing-IPC replay, and interrupted transaction rollback. Synthetic OPEN/baseline and GET-only fake venue are explicit.

All started jobs require reconciliation, including COMPLETED. No process result independently releases risk or authorizes a trade; process exit alone is not proof of database rollback or immediate session lock release.

qa.boundary: One isolated temporary PostgreSQL/Redis harness at a time. Unix socket DSN pinned to v2_isolated_qa; dedicated V2 external TCP block, reinstalled in spawned child; no runtime DB or exchange access.
qa.scope: 43 selected related files. Not all repository tests, production process-group acceptance, real exchange acceptance or profitability research.

intermediate_runs.note: All 13 fairness fixtures lacked FILLED exchange-outcome evidence and were correctly rejected. Four real spawn/PG cases and existing settlement tests passed. Predates lock-free stop flag completion and stronger rollback evidence.
Fairness fixtures corrected and rerun; overlaps selected regression.

fixture_corrections: FILLED fixtures now include explicit synthetic QA outcome evidence. Removed an invalid extra typed-plan fixture instead of weakening Orders.prepare checks or altering immutable evidence.

Independent review found account-lock reacquisition plus MVCC count=0 insufficient to prove a separate writer connection rolled back. Final test adds a negative control and requires ACCESS EXCLUSIVE table lock acquisition before confirming zero rows.

selected_regression.note: Before strengthening the rollback-only acceptance assertion. Production source is unchanged after this run; final test-only change separately rerun.

final_supplemental.note: Final stronger rollback negative control and exclusive-lock proof. These 103 cases overlap the selected regression; counts are not added.

independent_review.qa_finding: Separate uncommitted writer transaction was initially not proven ended by MVCC count=0.
independent_review.resolution: Negative control confirms count=0 while writer still holds its table lock. After kill, reacquire actual protocol lock and independently ACCESS EXCLUSIVE table lock before asserting zero rows.
independent_review.remaining_scope: Same-instance cursor fairness only; no claim of cross-job cursor transfer, controller wiring, fencing or production latency.

read_only_service_observation.scope: Service metadata only; no current exchange position query or close action.

remaining_before_activation: BoundedProcessJob is not wired into the controller. Complete direct process-group ownership/shutdown; killing a parent must not leave a settlement grandchild. Unconfirmed stop must prohibit account replacement.
Add account epoch/token verification within short financial commit transactions without holding the route row lock across settlement network calls. The primitive provides no such fencing.

Retain financial and outcome cursors in the parent across disposable jobs, with explicit work selection and existing stage-level mutual exclusion. Current fairness only applies to consecutive runs of the same stage instance; each fresh test job recreates it.
Account locks are still shared with protection/exits; QA proves bounded recovery under continued polling and successful termination, not zero contention or an unconditional protection SLA.

poll/stop require regular parent scheduling; start/spawn/argument serialization is synchronous and outside their nonblocking guarantee. Targets must not spawn descendants and must open their own resources.

Post-timeout protection acceptance uses a flat synthetic account, not real open-position stop coverage. Historical-scale query cost, resource pressure and management heartbeat/alert projection remain unproven.
Typed entry worker, causal common opportunities, deterministic strategy comparison, real Testnet acceptance and runtime soak remain incomplete. Trading remains paused; no profitability claim.
